add_el_features: add elemental features to a pandas DataFrame using matminer featurizers on a composition column
run_add_el_features: run add_el_features on a DataFrame with XRF composition data to extract weighted average element properties
test_add_el_features: test add_el_features by passing a DataFrame with an xrf comp column and verifying new feature columns
refactor_add_el_features: refactor add_el_features to support a configurable list of element properties beyond the default six
review_add_el_features: review add_el_features to understand how StrToComposition and ElementProperty featurizers are applied to composition data
